blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: No street-by-street boundary is published; Official Community Plan (OCP) Bylaw, 2026, No. 3522, groups Heritage Mountain, Twin Creeks, Noons Creek, Mountain Meadows and Heritage Woods in one section.
Western streets: Ravine Drive, Noons Creek Drive, Lansdowne Drive, via Heritage Mountain Boulevard; Bert Flinn Park north.
Heritage Mountain Elementary, 125 Ravine Drive, anchors this side; Heritage Woods Secondary, 1300 David Avenue, is east, in Heritage Woods.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Detached homes and townhouses, plus few apartments, in a relatively new grouping; detached houses are freehold.
Sub-areas here: Twin Creeks, Noons Creek, around Noons Creek Drive; Mountain Meadows Elementary, 999 Noons Creek Drive.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Zoning Bylaw, 2018, No. 2937 puts detached homes in Single Detached Residential (RS) zones; check a lot on ViewPort.
Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH), Bylaw No. 3460 (2024): four units on lots 280–4,050 square metres, six within 400 metres of frequent bus stops; title building schemes override SSMUH.
Secondary suite: maximum 90 square metres, 40 percent of floor space, never stratified; allowed since 2004.
Small-lot subdivision (RS1-S, 9 metres, 325 square metres) applies only in Moody Centre, Seaview, Pleasantside.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Heritage Mountain Park, 20 Parkglen Place: soccer field, two ball diamonds, washroom key only with rental.
Dogs off leash only on Bert Flinn Park's gravel trail at David Avenue, plus a morning mini-loop pilot.
No library here; the only branch is at 100 Newport Drive.
OCP policy: vehicle access from local roads only, prohibited from arterial roads.
Bear Smart since 2024: landscaping beside sensitive areas uses the Preferred Plant List.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Coronation Park (2) — Inlet District, Wesgroup, rezoning: open for input; amended Phase A permit approved October 13, 2026.
Moody Centre Transit-Oriented Development Area — OCP amendment: input on hold; Beedie Living permit (CD94) authorised October 13, 2026.
No project inside these streets was listed on Engage (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: 2026 rate, Bylaw No. 3541: general 1.61574 per $1,000, plus police 0.70211, asset renewal 0.24678.
Taxes due July 2, 2026: 5 percent penalty after, 5 percent more after September 15.
2026 single-family utility bill: $1,892, water, sewer, garbage, green waste, recycling; due February 27, 2026.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Houses: getting around

items.t: Route 184, Moody Centre Station / Noons Creek: Falcon Drive, Noons Creek Drive, Panorama Drive, Lansdowne Drive.
Route 183: Heritage Mountain Boulevard, David Avenue, stopping at Inlet Centre Station, Ioco Road.

blocks.text: Heritage Mountain Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check Development Permit Areas 4 and 5 on OCP Map 13 and ViewPort for slope or creek lots.
OCP hazards: flooding, debris flows, landslip, rockfalls, earthquake, Maps 14 and 16; steep slopes need geotechnical investigation.
Forest-interface wildfire risk is managed under the Community Wildfire Protection Plan; see FireSmart.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Heritage Mountain

Up on Port Moody’s north shore, Heritage Mountain is a hillside neighbourhood. Homes backing onto Bert Flinn Park, the views and the Heritage Mountain Elementary catchment are the draws, and City policy aims to keep its residential, forested character.

Heritage Mountain home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

19 houses sold in Heritage Mountain with a median price of $1,750,000 (the middle half sold between $1,676,500 and $2,070,000), taking a median of 14 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $460 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median lot of 6,543 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Heritage Mountain?
faq.a: 11, in the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® month-end figures for October 2026. Listings change every day; Jared can tell you what is available now.

faq.q: Is Heritage Mountain a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Heritage Mountain had no published sales ratio for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Heritage Mountain from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Between June and October 2026, 10 houses sold in Heritage Mountain; Port Moody as a whole recorded 64.

Heritage Mountain Elementary at 125 Ravine Drive is the named Kindergarten to Grade 5 school here, but School District No. 43 (SD43) catchment follows the permanent home address, so please confirm the exact address in the SD43 School Locator first.

faq.q: Can I add a coach house?
faq.a: Yes, if the lot meets the SSMUH RS1 rules: a laneway, coach house or accessory dwelling unit may be built with no lane access required, each suite counts toward the lot total, and only one suite is allowed per primary unit.

faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station here?
faq.a: No station is in Heritage Mountain. Buses 183 and 184 connect to Inlet Centre and Moody Centre stations on the Millennium Line; route 184 runs via Noons Creek Drive and Panorama Drive to Lansdowne Drive, so buyers plan a bus leg.

faq.q: Can I remove a large tree?
faq.a: Not freely on a development site: a tree removal permit and arborist report are required, Tree Protection Bylaw, 2026, No. 3531 regulates cutting on private and public property, and clearing March 1 to August 31 may require a nesting survey.

faq.q: What did houses in Heritage Mountain sell for?
faq.a: From November 2025 to late October 2026, Heritage Mountain recorded 19 house sales at a median of $1,750,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Heritage Mountain?
faq.a: Half sold in 14 days or less, at a median 97.1% of the last list price; 11% went over asking (sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).
